description: Golden reference for PEEC-inductance on a 3-turn loft coil (multi-turn, tight pancake).
rationale: Locks in the cross-section-centroid chain method for loft-of-profiles solids.  Kubota's 3turncoil geometry (385 circle cross-sections spiralled through 3 turns, Z-pitch ~1.3mm) is the acid test for the centroid NN-chain with tangent continuity: naive NN jumps between turns and doubles the path length.  STEP-only path (no sibling .jou) is what the test asserts.

sample.comment: File lives on Kubota's 100号機 share (W:) not in-repo (10 MB).  Test skips if unavailable rather than duplicating the 10 MB in the repo.

reference_jou_path.comment: The .jou explicit-centerline parser produces 426.25 nH.  Treat this as the 'ground truth' for the cross-section-centroid method -- agreement within 2% confirms the NN chain traversed all 385 cross-sections in the correct order.

regression_guard.comment: Hard band around the .jou reference.  2026-04-21 bugs that hit this: (1) longest-edge heuristic on loft-of-circles gave L=4.78 nH, (2) GeomType string compare 'PLANE' missed enum; (3) NN chain without tangent continuity got path=1280mm (~2x) and L off.
